$description: Motion. Source: Motion System, Durations, Curves, Springs.

slide.$description: The switch knob where no spring applies

press.$description: dur-press: the press scale of buttons

fast.$description: dur-fast: background, border, and text color

spin.$description: One turn of a spinner: 1,000 ms

base.$description: dur-base: the text color of a segment, and the opacity of rows.

shimmer.$description: One cycle of the shimmer of a skeleton, and one cycle of an indeterminate bar.

shimmer-limit.$description: The shimmer stops after this time, and a status text shows.

spinner-delay.$description: A spinner shows only after a wait of this time.

pulse.$description: One cycle of the opacity pulse of the spinner with reduced motion, from 1 to 0.4 and back.

out.$description: ease-out: entrances and all moves into place

standard.$description: ease: the press scale and the change of color

in.$description: ease-in: exits, for example the exit of a menu or a select list.

in-out.$description: ease-in-out: a move from one position to a different position, and expand and collapse

linear.$description: linear: progress that follows time, the turn of the spinner, and the loops of the shimmer.

control.$description: spring-control: switch knob, checkbox mark, segmented pill, tab indicator, slider thumb. The transition value is the fallback: the settle time and ease-out.

quick.$description: spring-quick: keyboard and TV focus, the radio indicator with the keyboard. The transition value is the fallback: the settle time and ease-out.
